# telnyx_network_coverage (Data Source)

The locations where network interfaces can be deployed, and the interfaces each supports.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_location_code` (String) The code of associated location to filter on.
- `filter_location_pop` (String) The POP of associated location to filter on.
- `filter_location_region` (String) The region of associated location to filter on.
- `filter_location_site` (String) The site of associated location to filter on.
- `filters_available_services` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `network_coverage` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_coverage))

<a id="nestedatt--network_coverage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_coverage`

Read-Only:

- `available_services` (List of String) List of interface types supported in this region.
- `location` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_coverage--location))
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--network_coverage--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_coverage.location`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Location code.
- `name` (String) Human readable name of location.
- `pop` (String) Point of presence of location.
- `region` (String) Identifies the geographical region of location.
